description.p: t-code is a native C and C++ editor with a project file tree, editor tabs, a terminal, and clangd language support. Work with Git changes, render Markdown previews, and build and debug programs from the editor.

ul.li: Complete code, navigate symbols, and apply clangd quick fixes
Review Git diffs and edit several files in split views
Run Make, CMake, and Meson builds and the project's tasks

screenshot.caption: C and C++ editing with a project tree and terminal

description.p: A log file for warnings, opened from the Help menu, and fixes:

ul.li: A word typed at several cursors is undone in one step
A long breadcrumb no longer widens the editor
The Outline panel forgets its widgets once they are gone
Socket requests are dropped while the window closes

description.p: Multiple cursors, project-wide replace with a preview, snippets, inlay hints, an Outline panel, breadcrumbs, call and type hierarchy, Git branches, pull, fetch, stash and line blame, and more language servers.
Fixes update release URL launching from dialog and compile commands string escaping for clangd.
Plugins system, Problems panel, Tasks runner, Crash recovery, Flatpak, Snap, AUR support, and test suite improvements.
Adds a GDB debugger, code folding, quick fixes, and configurable themes.
